Their background is heavily focused on full-stack web development, DevOps, and open-source tooling, with no evidence of hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or AI accelerator optimization experience.

Strong open-source contributions and community engagement (e.g., GISCollective)
Demonstrated ability to build and optimize high-performance systems (e.g., DLang low-latency apps)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC, IP modeling, or AI accelerator hardware design
